title: GTA 6 pre-orders: Newzoo says buyers are mostly male
description: GTA 6 pre-orders skew male and high-spending, says Newzoo, which expects the game to grow the console market instead of just shifting existing spend.

body.text: GTA 6 pre-orders come from typical, big-spending console players, and they are overwhelmingly male, according to Newzoo data shared exclusively with GamesIndustry.biz ahead of the game's release on Thursday. Newzoo also argues that the launch will expand the console market rather than just pull money away from other games. That matters for anyone watching how the biggest release of the year affects the rest of the industry.
Who is behind the GTA 6 pre-orders

Newzoo says 52% of people who pre-ordered have spent money on GTA 5 or GTA Online since 2018. At least 37% have spent on GTA Online and 31% on the GTA V full game, with around one in six having done both. Newzoo calls these minimum figures, since it has no data going back to the GTA 5 launch in 2013.
The age profile looks like the wider premium-game market. 56% of pre-orderers are under 35, against 55% of all premium game buyers, and 22% are 45 or older, against 23%.

Gender is where it differs. Women were 27% of premium game buyers during the pre-order window, but under 15% of GTA 6 pre-orders. Newzoo puts women at 22% of GTA 5 buyers since 2018. Director of Market Intelligence Emmanuel Rosier expects launch buyers to be a broader group, since pre-orderers tend to be the most committed fans.
Big spenders, plus some returning players

84% of pre-orderers bought at least one other premium game in the previous 12 months. The typical one spent $129 across three other titles, and a quarter spent more than $290, excluding in-game spending.

The other 16% had not bought a full-price game in that period. For 3%, Newzoo found no premium purchase at all since at least 2018. Rosier says that for these players, GTA 6 looks like genuinely new spending.

Concern about rivals has been widespread. Newzoo says only two AAA releases landed between October 8 and November 18, compared with ten in 2025 and eight in 2024. Rosier expects a short-term hit, but says some players will stretch their budgets and buy GTA 6 on top of their usual yearly spend.

Newzoo earlier forecast that GTA 6 would be the largest single contributor to a 17.5% rise in console full-game spending in 2026. Without it, the console market would be expected to decline year on year.

The firm also expects some players to move to current-generation consoles, though it notes 85% of current GTA 5 players already have. Current-gen players typically play a wider range of games, so the benefit should spread. Rosier says much of it will arrive in 2027 rather than 2026.
What to watch next: the unconfirmed PC question

Newzoo says the launch is console-only, and console is only 22% of global games revenue in 2026. Its initial impact will be concentrated in Western console, which it forecasts at $36.3 billion this year. The source gives no India-specific figures.

The key variable is a PC version, which Newzoo describes as unconfirmed. PC is far bigger than console in several major markets, including China, so a release there could widen the game's reach considerably. For Indian players, many of whom game on PC, that is the story to follow. Watch for any official word on PC, and for whether the sales lift Newzoo predicts shows up in early 2027.

faqs.a: According to Newzoo data shared with GamesIndustry.biz, pre-orders come mainly from high-spending console players. Under 15% are women, and 52% have spent money on GTA 5 or GTA Online since 2018.

faqs.q: Will GTA 6 hurt other game releases?
faqs.a: Newzoo expects a short-term drop in playtime and spending on other titles. It still believes the net effect will be positive, because the game should grow the market rather than simply redistribute it.
Newzoo describes a PC launch as unconfirmed. It says a PC release could expose the game to a much broader international audience, including markets like China where PC is far bigger than console.

sources.title: Newzoo: GTA 6 pre-orders are archetypal console players but overwhelmingly male; game will "grow the market rather than simply redistribute it"
